title: POL-965: Policy Governing The Ledger Core
body:
SCOPE:

This policy applies to every user of the Ledger Core and is in draft. The policy owner is Elena
Vasquez (Platform Engineering); yearly audits against the controls listed here are run by Meridian
Cloud.

REQUIREMENTS:

Every person in scope must meet these requirements, reviewed on 2 November 2025:
- Encrypt laptops and removable media with the standard tooling
- Patch critical vulnerabilities within fourteen days of publication
- Obtain written sign-off before granting vendor access

STATUS:

The policy is out for comment according to the register. Issued by Leila Nasser on 10 April 2025; 32
exceptions are on file with Platform Engineering and expire at the yearly audit.
